(define (encode str)
  (define (helper s count acc)
    (if (null? s)
        (reverse! acc)
        (let ((char (car s)))
          (if (= count 1)
              (helper (cdr s) 0 (cons char acc))
              (helper (cdr s) (- count 1) (cons count acc))))))
  (list (helper (string->list str) 0 '())))
